title: D3 pcpdaab — PDF resolver metadata (Administrative Appeals Board decisions)
description: One JSON per (row, lang) at output/d3/pcpdaab/{year}/{num}/pcpdaab_{year}_{num}_{lang}.json alongside a matching .pdf and .txt (PDF-extracted plain text) — 735 of each on disk. Bilingual only: {lang} ∈ {en, tc}; no _sc sidecars (unlike the other three D3 families which are en/tc/sc) — pcpdaab.py's _PCPD_LANG_URL_PREFIX map only defines en/tc routes. HKLII does not serve pcpdaab PDFs directly (its /static/ URLs return SPA HTML); the pcpdaab runner resolves each row against pcpd.org.hk's public decisions listing. See src/hklii_downloader/pcpdaab.py.

hklii.description: Metadata as scraped from HKLII's getother response.

anchor_text.description: Raw anchor text from the pcpd.org.hk decisions listing.

chinese_only.description: TRUE when the pcpd.org.hk listing marks this PDF as 'provides Chinese version only'. This is an intrinsic property of the PDF (not of the sidecar's language) and is written identically to both the _en and _tc sidecars for that decision. In the current corpus 197/368 EN sidecars and 197/367 TC sidecars carry chinese_only:true. Trust this flag over the _en filename when determining the language of the underlying decision.

shares_pdf_with.description: Other AAB (year, num) partner tuples that share this PDF (batched decisions). Empty on all rows in the current corpus; the runner writes non-empty tuples when a single anchor spans multiple AAB numbers. See src/hklii_downloader/pcpdaab.py:60.

resolved_year.description: Canonical year parsed from anchor text (may differ from filename in edge cases).

resolved_num.description: Canonical decision number parsed from anchor text.
